g.text: Turn 7: activate, arrive and seat (2 of 4)
Entry: turn 6 complete. C1 PAID; C2 READY_TO_PAY at T2. T1 is free.
Wrong phase/reuse throws IllegalStateException before any change.
UI only offers HAPPY_HOUR when happyHourAvailable. Seating uses static methods.
beginTurn(true): valid TURN_START, unused Happy Hour
Adds "Happy Hour activated" to local events.
recoverWaitingCustomers calls recover(15) on existing C1/C2.
PAID/READY_TO_PAY exclude recovery; C3 does not exist yet.
TurnStart: activation then arrival event; remaining 2
Host action: queued ID and free table required
Failed seating preconditions return rejected before effects; phase remains HOST.
Routine checks/accessors are omitted. Host and Waiter share Seating.
TakeOrderAndPrepare continues with ORDER C3 in this same turn.
this diagram shows only the turn-7 excerpt.
